customTones.title: General (기본 교정)
customTones.instruction: Correct the grammar, fix awkward phrasing, and make it sound natural and like a native English speaker.

customTones.title: Polite & Professional (비즈니스 이메일)
customTones.instruction: Write in a professional, polite, and formal tone, suitable for business emails, official correspondence, or corporate communications.

customTones.title: Casual & Friendly (일상 회화/메신저)
customTones.instruction: Write in a casual, friendly, and conversational tone, suitable for everyday messaging, social media, or talking to colleagues/friends.

customTones.title: Concise & Direct (간결하게)
customTones.instruction: Write in a highly concise, direct, and straight-to-the-point tone. Avoid unnecessary words while keeping it grammatically correct and natural.

customTones.title: Academic (논문/보고서)
customTones.instruction: Write in an academic, formal, and sophisticated tone, suitable for research papers, essays, or formal reports using advanced vocabulary.
